name: apt
summary: Advanced Package Tool (package manager for Debian/Ubuntu).
description: Command-line interface for package management, handling installation, upgrades, and removal of software packages.

options.description: Download new lists of packages from repositories.
Perform safe upgrade of all installed packages.

examples.title: Install git package
examples.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y git
examples.output:
Reading package lists... Done
Building dependency tree...
Setting up git (1:2.34.1)...
examples.explanation: Updates package index and installs Git non-interactively.

warnings: apt installs packages with root privileges, and package maintainer scripts run arbitrary code; install only from trusted repositories.
